mapper.sql: id, category_id, service_name, service_code, service_icon, service_images, service_desc, service_detail, price, market_price, unit, duration, sort, sales_count, status, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM service_item WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1
SELECT FROM service_item WHERE category_id = #{categoryId} AND status = 1 ORDER BY sort ASC, sales_count DESC, create_time DESC
SELECT si.* FROM service_item si INNER JOIN package_service_rel psr ON si.id = psr.service_id WHERE psr.package_id = #{packageId} AND si.status = 1 ORDER BY psr.sort ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO service_item (category_id, service_name, service_code, service_icon, service_images, service_desc, service_detail, price, market_price, unit, duration, sort, sales_count, status) VALUES (#{categoryId}, #{serviceName}, #{serviceCode}, #{serviceIcon}, #{serviceImages}, #{serviceDesc}, #{serviceDetail}, #{price}, #{marketPrice}, #{unit}, #{duration}, #{sort}, #{salesCount}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE service_item SET category_id = #{categoryId}, service_name = #{serviceName}, service_code = #{serviceCode}, service_icon = #{serviceIcon}, service_images = #{serviceImages}, service_desc = #{serviceDesc}, service_detail = #{serviceDetail}, price = #{price}, market_price = #{marketPrice}, unit = #{unit}, duration = #{duration}, sort = #{sort}, sales_count = #{salesCount}, status = #{status}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete: UPDATE service_item SET status = 0 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE service_item SET status = #{status}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE service_item SET sales_count = sales_count + #{count}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
